status.monster_wave.name: Monster Wave
status.monster_wave.risk.value: Estimated burst loss %s points / reserve %s points
status.monster_wave.reconnect.waiting: Waiting to check the run after rejoining
status.monster_wave.manual.note: Applies to this connection only; reconnecting restores automatic detection.
status.monster_wave.action_note: Requires an enabled module and a multiplayer connection.
status.monster_wave.force.message: Start recording and health-loss protection immediately. Insufficient reserve triggers an early disconnect; health below 4 points (2 hearts) disconnects immediately. Reconnecting restores automatic mode.
status.monster_wave.stop.message: Stop this recording and low-health protection. Reconnecting restores automatic detection.
setting.monster_wave.enabled.description: Detect and record Monster Wave. Disconnect early when recent health losses leave insufficient reserve; always disconnect below 4 health points.
disconnect.monster_wave.burst_risk: Monster Wave: disconnected early because recent health losses indicate insufficient reserve for another burst.
disconnect.monster_wave.low_health: Monster Wave: disconnected automatically because health fell below 4 points.
